title.en: Name a conversation when you create it
title.zh: 新建会话时可填写标题

description.en: Left blank, it is named after the first message.
description.zh: 留空时按第一条消息自动命名。

title.en: Connected apps in workspace settings now opens
title.zh: 工作区设置中的「已连接的应用」可正常打开

title.en: A narrow window keeps the full workspace layout
title.zh: 窗口较窄时工作区保持完整布局

title.en: Intro slides no longer cover the page dots
title.zh: 介绍页不再遮挡底部页码

description.en: This Computer and the workspace share one clearer, more consistent look.
description.zh: 「此电脑」与工作区采用统一的新设计，层次更清晰，风格更一致。

description.en: Up to five people, online first; + invites new members.
description.zh: 最多显示五人，在线成员优先；「+」用于邀请新成员。

title.en: Files from agents can be downloaded right away
title.zh: 智能体生成的文件可立即下载
